name: Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — 1 Basic — Map the Skies

system.description:
Whispers of the Heavens depends on the sorcerer's ability to see the stars; all uses of the path suffer a bonus difficulty Trait in overcast weather and two in storms, and cannot be used at all if the sky is hidden. The first technique a student learns is divining her own location with a glance at the stars.

Make a Static Mental Challenge. The number of successes determines how accurately the character can fix her location; with an accurate map on hand, one success pinpoints her position to within a day's travel, and each additional success narrows this considerably, to within a mile at four or more successes.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
